matches.rationale: The finding discusses the gradient loss formula (Eq. 12) and its signed-max property, not the cross-attention query-swap issue in Section 4.3.1; no finding addresses the query/key mismatch.

The finding critiques the mathematical correctness of the gradient loss's signed max operation, not the ambiguity about whether losses are applied symmetrically to both modalities or only the fused output; different locus and different issue.
